# Feature matrix

<!-- Generated by scripts/feature-matrix.mjs from docs/features.json. Do not edit; change the JSON and run `node scripts/feature-matrix.mjs`. -->

A cell says `tested` only when an automated test in this repository runs that feature on that target; the test and the CI job that runs it are listed under [Evidence](#evidence). A simulator, an emulator or a build loaded in desktop Chromium is named as such there: no cell claims a physical TV, phone or Apple device.

- **tested**: an automated test runs it on that target.
- **preview**: implemented on main, with no automated test on that target.
- **in progress**: in an open pull request, not on main.
- **no**: not implemented on that target.

## Rendering backends

| Feature                                            | web    | tizen   | webos   | vizio   | roku    | android | android-tv | ios     | apple-tv | desktop-linux | desktop-windows | desktop-macos |
| -------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------- | ------- | ------- | ------- | ------- | ---------- | ------- | -------- | ------------- | --------------- | ------------- |
| WebGL backend (`packages/renderer/webgl`)          | tested | preview | preview | preview | no      | preview | preview    | preview | preview  | preview       | preview         | preview       |
| Canvas 2D backend (`packages/renderer/canvas`)     | tested | preview | preview | preview | no      | no      | no         | no      | no       | no            | no              | no            |
| Roku SceneGraph backend (`packages/renderer/roku`) | no     | no      | no      | no      | preview | no      | no         | no      | no       | no            | no              | no            |

Notes:

- WebGL backend (`packages/renderer/webgl`), tizen, webos, vizio: Same backend as web. The generated Tizen build is only smoke-run in desktop Chromium; no TV hardware.
- WebGL backend (`packages/renderer/webgl`), android, android-tv, ios, apple-tv: NativeScript canvas host. CI builds the app; no test asserts what it draws.
- WebGL backend (`packages/renderer/webgl`), desktop-linux, desktop-windows, desktop-macos: Node + FFI host with SDL3, being replaced by the Rust + Hermes runtime.
- Canvas 2D backend (`packages/renderer/canvas`), tizen, webos, vizio: `build <target> --legacy`. The Tizen legacy build is only smoke-run in desktop Chromium.
- Roku SceneGraph backend (`packages/renderer/roku`), roku: Passes the conformance cases on an in-browser fake of the Roku SDK (tests/webgl/conformance-roku.test.tsx). A fake is not the target.

- Accessibility semantics (`src/sdk/semantics.ts`), web: `browserSemantics`; the app registers each node itself.
- Accessibility semantics (`src/sdk/semantics.ts`), desktop-linux, desktop-windows, desktop-macos: `hosts/desktop/semantics.mjs` on the Node + FFI host.

## SDK services

- `settings` (`src/sdk/services.ts`), roku: The app installs `rokuServices(section)` itself.
- `secureStorage` (`src/sdk/services.ts`), android, ios: The app supplies `@nativescript/secure-storage`.
- `secureStorage` (`src/sdk/services.ts`), desktop-linux, desktop-windows, desktop-macos: Only when the app passes a keyring module to `desktopServices`.
- `links` (`src/sdk/services.ts`), android: The app passes `androidLinks()` to `mobileServices`.
- `links` (`src/sdk/services.ts`), ios: The app passes `appleLinks()` to `mobileServices`.
- `notifications` (`src/sdk/services.ts`), android, ios: The app supplies `@nativescript/local-notifications`.
- `push` (`src/sdk/services.ts`), web: Only when the app installs `webAppServices(namespace, registration)` with its own service worker. Not verified end to end.
- `push` (`src/sdk/services.ts`), ios: The app supplies a configured Firebase Messaging instance. Not verified end to end.
- `jobs` (`src/sdk/services.ts`), web: Only with the app's own service worker and Background Sync.
- `jobs` (`src/sdk/services.ts`), android: The app passes `androidJobs(registry)`.
- `jobs` (`src/sdk/services.ts`), ios: The app passes `appleJobs(identifiers)`.
- `menus` (`src/sdk/menus.ts`), desktop-linux, desktop-windows, desktop-macos: Installed by `hosts/desktop/run.mjs` on the Node + FFI host.
- `updateDelivery` (`src/sdk/update.ts`), desktop-linux, desktop-windows, desktop-macos: `hosts/desktop/updater.mjs`, when the app calls `wire()`.
- `updateSource` (`src/sdk/update.ts`), desktop-linux, desktop-windows, desktop-macos: `hosts/desktop/updater.mjs`, when the app configures a feed.

## CLI commands

A command is `tested` for a target when a CI job runs it for that target and checks the result.

| Feature                                      | web     | tizen   | webos   | vizio   | roku    | android | android-tv | ios     | apple-tv | desktop-linux | desktop-windows | desktop-macos |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------- | ------- | ------- | ------- | ------- | ------- | ---------- | ------- | -------- | ------------- | --------------- | ------------- |
| `solid-platform init`                        | tested  | tested  | preview | preview | tested  | preview | tested     | tested  | tested   | tested        | preview         | preview       |
| `solid-platform build <target>`              | tested  | tested  | preview | preview | tested  | preview | tested     | tested  | tested   | preview       | preview         | preview       |
| `solid-platform dev <web\|desktop>`          | preview | no      | no      | no      | no      | no      | no         | no      | no       | preview       | preview         | preview       |
| `solid-platform plugin new`                  | tested  | tested  | preview | preview | tested  | preview | tested     | tested  | tested   | tested        | preview         | preview       |
| `solid-platform check [target]`              | tested  | tested  | preview | preview | tested  | preview | preview    | preview | preview  | tested        | preview         | preview       |
| `solid-platform explain <target> <module>`   | preview | preview | preview | preview | preview | preview | preview    | preview | preview  | preview       | preview         | preview       |
| `solid-platform package desktop`             | no      | no      | no      | no      | no      | no      | no         | no      | no       | preview       | preview         | preview       |
| `solid-platform certify roku <metrics.json>` | no      | no      | no      | no      | preview | no      | no         | no      | no       | no            | no              | no            |
| `solid-platform add video <release.tgz>`     | preview | preview | preview | preview | preview | preview | tested     | tested  | tested   | preview       | preview         | preview       |

Notes:

- `solid-platform build <target>`, desktop-linux: CI runs `plugins run desktop` only, not `build desktop`.
- `solid-platform explain <target> <module>`, web, tizen, webos, vizio, roku, android, android-tv, ios, apple-tv, desktop-linux, desktop-windows, desktop-macos: The resolver has a unit test (tests/cli/variants.test.mjs); the command is not run for a target in CI.
- `solid-platform package desktop`, desktop-linux, desktop-windows, desktop-macos: The `Desktop packages` workflow runs only when started by hand.

- Web app with service worker and manifest, web: CI builds it; no test checks the service worker or the manifest.
- Browser TV package (Tizen `.wgt`, webOS `.ipk`), tizen: The `.wgt` is made only when `TIZEN_SECURITY_PROFILE` is set; CI does not set it.

- Browser TV package (Tizen `.wgt`, webOS `.ipk`), vizio: The build output is a hosted web app; there is no package step.
- Desktop archive (`.tar.gz` with runtime), desktop-linux, desktop-windows, desktop-macos: Packages the Node + FFI host that is being replaced.

## Evidence

Each tested cell, with the test file that covers it, the workflow and job that run it, and what it checks.

- WebGL backend (`packages/renderer/webgl`), web: packages/platform/tests/webgl/conformance-webgl.test.tsx (test.yml: browser; scene conformance cases in Chromium on real WebGL)
- Canvas 2D backend (`packages/renderer/canvas`), web: packages/platform/tests/webgl/conformance-canvas.test.tsx (test.yml: browser; scene conformance cases in Chromium on Canvas 2D)
- Flex layout (`src/core/flexLayout.ts`), web: packages/platform/tests/webgl/flex-text.test.tsx (test.yml: browser; flex rows and columns with measured text in Chromium)
- Text rendering, web: packages/platform/tests/webgl/flex-text.test.tsx (test.yml: browser; text is laid out and measured by the WebGL backend in Chromium)
- Focus and key handling, web: packages/platform/tests/cli/browser-smoke.mjs (test.yml: projects, called by tests/cli/projects-smoke.sh; Enter on the focused row of the generated web app in Chromium)
- Playback adapter (`packages/video`), ios, apple-tv: packages/platform/tests/cli/apple-smoke.sh (test.yml: apple; AVPlayer opens a clip, plays until time advances, pauses and seeks in a simulator, not on a physical device)
- `solid-platform init`, web, tizen, roku, desktop-linux: packages/platform/tests/cli/projects-smoke.sh (test.yml: projects; init --targets web,desktop,roku,tizen from the packed package on Linux)
- `solid-platform init`, android-tv: packages/platform/tests/cli/android-smoke.sh (android.yml: android)
- `solid-platform init`, ios, apple-tv: packages/platform/tests/cli/apple-smoke.sh (test.yml: apple)
- `solid-platform build <target>`, web: packages/platform/tests/cli/projects-smoke.sh (test.yml: projects; the build is then loaded in Chromium)
- `solid-platform build <target>`, tizen: packages/platform/tests/cli/projects-smoke.sh (test.yml: projects; build and build --legacy, each then loaded in Chromium)
- `solid-platform build <target>`, roku: packages/platform/tests/cli/projects-smoke.sh (test.yml: projects; the channel zip's contents are asserted)
- `solid-platform build <target>`, android-tv: packages/platform/tests/cli/android-smoke.sh (android.yml: android; the debug APK's contents are asserted)
- `solid-platform build <target>`, ios, apple-tv: packages/platform/tests/cli/apple-smoke.sh (test.yml: apple; simulator build, then launched)
- `solid-platform plugin new`, web: packages/platform/tests/cli/projects-smoke.sh (test.yml: projects; the generated plugin is invoked from the built app in Chromium)
- `solid-platform plugin new`, tizen: packages/platform/tests/cli/projects-smoke.sh (test.yml: projects; the generated plugin is invoked from the Tizen build in Chromium)
- `solid-platform plugin new`, roku: packages/platform/tests/cli/projects-smoke.sh (test.yml: projects; the plugin's component is asserted inside the channel zip)
- `solid-platform plugin new`, android-tv: packages/platform/tests/cli/android-smoke.sh (android.yml: android; Kotlin, JNI, service and sidecar plugins are asserted inside the APK)
- `solid-platform plugin new`, ios, apple-tv: packages/platform/tests/cli/apple-smoke.sh (test.yml: apple; the Swift plugin returns its result in a simulator)
- `solid-platform plugin new`, desktop-linux: packages/platform/tests/cli/projects-smoke.sh (test.yml: projects; `plugins run desktop` prints the plugin's result)
- `solid-platform check [target]`, web, tizen, roku, desktop-linux: packages/platform/tests/cli/projects-smoke.sh (test.yml: projects; `pnpm check` in an app with these four targets)
- `solid-platform add video <release.tgz>`, android-tv: packages/platform/tests/cli/android-smoke.sh (android.yml: android; the Media3 player is asserted inside the APK)
- `solid-platform add video <release.tgz>`, ios, apple-tv: packages/platform/tests/cli/apple-smoke.sh (test.yml: apple; the added adapter plays a clip in a simulator)
- Roku channel zip, roku: packages/platform/tests/cli/projects-smoke.sh (test.yml: projects; opens the zip and asserts its components)
- Android debug APK, android-tv: packages/platform/tests/cli/android-smoke.sh (android.yml: android; asserts the APK and its three ABI slices; not installed on a device in CI)
- Apple simulator app, ios, apple-tv: packages/platform/tests/cli/apple-smoke.sh (test.yml: apple; installed and launched in a simulator)
